name: easyclip
description: Free: turn any long video or link into Shorts/Reels/TikToks - locally, token-lean. Top 3 moments, one clip at a time.
long_description: Paste a file path or a YouTube/Twitch/Kick link. EasyClip analyses the video on your computer, finds the top 3 moments and renders vertical clips with hook text, plus a pre-posting policy check. Claude only reads short tables, never video frames. Want batch clips, captions, recaps, thumbnails, chat spikes and more? Get EasyClip Pro.
